formulas.description: QCC_Cases to Exception queue if contact is blank
formulas.name: IsQCC_CasestoExceptionqueue
formulas.expression: ( {!$Record.RecordType.Name} = 'CCC Baggage' || {!$Record.RecordType.Name} = 'CCC Complaints' || {!$Record.RecordType.Name} = 'CCC Compliment' || {!$Record.RecordType.Name} = 'CCC Email Bounced Back' || {!$Record.RecordType.Name} = 'CCC Event' || {!$Record.RecordType.Name} = 'CCC Further Action Required' || {!$Record.RecordType.Name} = 'CCC Insurance Letter Case' || {!$Record.RecordType.Name} = 'CCC Medical' || {!$Record.RecordType.Name} = 'CCC Offload' || {!$Record.RecordType.Name} = 'CCC On The Spot Recovery' || {!$Record.RecordType.Name} = 'CCC Query' || {!$Record.RecordType.Name} = 'CCC Refund' ) && ( ISBLANK( {!$Record.ContactId} ) ) && ( ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'Email') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'Phone') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'Web') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'Internal - Terminal') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'Internal - Other') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'In Person') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'Post') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'Voice') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'Webchat') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'Social Media') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'QF Internal') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'Red App') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'Qantas.com') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'Event') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'SMS') ) || ( ISPICKVAL( {!$Record.Origin},'VIP Service Team Email Enquiries') ) )

formulas.name: QCC_CasePopulateFieldsFromContact_Criteria
formulas.expression: ( ISCHANGED({!$Record.ContactId} ) || ISNEW() ) && NOT(ISBLANK( {!$Record.ContactId} ) ) && ( CONTAINS({!$Label.QCC_Case_RecordType_for_populating_fields_from_Contact} , {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} ) || ( {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} = 'CCC_Complaints' && TEXT({!$Record.Group__c}) = 'Post Flight Survey' ) )

formulas.name: SetFirstResponseTimevalueConditionFormula
formulas.expression: IF(PRIORVALUE({!$Record.Status})="In Progress"&& (TEXT({!$Record.Status})="Waiting for Customer") &&ISNULL({!$Record.First_email_to_customer__c})&&BEGINS({!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName}, "CCC") , True, False)
